items.description: visual composition did not match the premium court-centered design
items.leadingRootCause: the 7A rebuild kept the flat two-panel layout and never introduced an arena surface
items.implementedFix: ArenaCentre navy inset (EC mark, VS, preview) between the team panels; navy score hero, Ready tipoff band and loading
items.regressionTest: e2e R6 asserts a light page with a navy header

items.description: interface excessively dark, causing readability strain
items.leadingRootCause: every surface token was near-black, so all reading happened on #0b0e17
items.implementedFix: theme.js rewritten to warm ivory page / off-white cards / deep navy ink; 16px base type
items.regressionTest: v7b theme luminance test + e2e R6

items.description: all-white alternative too drastic
items.leadingRootCause: n/a — avoided by design
items.implementedFix: hybrid: light for reading surfaces, navy reserved for header, court, loading, score hero
items.regressionTest: e2e R6 asserts BOTH the light page and the navy header

items.description: coach selection cluttered; All Coaches view lost detail
items.leadingRootCause: three long scouting cards inline plus a name-only list for the other 22
items.implementedFix: CoachModal: search, system-family filter, sort, list + detail pane, one Select CTA
items.regressionTest: journeys J11 asserts search/filter/sort/detail; R2 asserts the phone modal

items.description: legacy Chemistry presented as if it drives Candidate 3
items.leadingRootCause: the legacy analyzeBalance multiplier was surfaced as a headline score next to engine output
items.implementedFix: RosterBalance replaces the meter with named strengths/tradeoffs and a 'does not decide the game' note; chemistry dial removed from postgame
items.verification: no chemistry number remains in the builder or postgame

items.description: pregame and postgame matchup reads disagreed
items.leadingRootCause: two implementations: /api/v3meta mapped edges to words, the postgame rendered the same model's raw numbers
items.implementedFix: api/_lib/pregameRead.js is the single implementation; /api/game stores the snapshot; postgame renders the stored object
items.verification: e2e P1 captures the Ready rows and asserts the postgame rows are identical

items.description: raw internal edge values exposed
items.leadingRootCause: the postgame EdgeBars printed the ±20 model scale
items.implementedFix: EdgeBars deleted; StoredPregameRead prints Even / Gold Edge / Strong Gold Edge only
items.regressionTest: e2e P2 scans all four postgame tabs

items.description: coach cards showed Era fit before an era was selected
items.leadingRootCause: eraStyle carried a default ('2020s') that was passed to the recommender during the coach stage
items.implementedFix: eraStyleId is undefined until eraLocked; the modal hides era fit and says where it appears
items.verification: modal shows the deferral note pre-era

items.description: two competing box scores
items.leadingRootCause: a legacy 5-column table and the possession box both rendered
items.implementedFix: one AuthoritativeBox built from the possession lines with reconciled totals
items.verification: one BOX SCORE heading; the other two strings are gone

items.description: personal fouls displayed with no foul-out/rotation system
items.leadingRootCause: the column was carried over from the possession box; the engine's own note says no disqualification is modelled
items.implementedFix: PF column removed
items.verification: no PF header in the DOM
items.regressionTest: e2e P6 asserts PF is absent

items.description: narrative contained contradictions and unsupported causal claims
items.leadingRootCause: the model was asked not to contradict the result but nothing verified the output
items.implementedFix: narrativeEvidence.js: evidence packet + claim validation; contradictions are rejected (MODEL_CONTRADICTED_RESULT) and the deterministic recap stands

items.description: duplicate real people on opposing teams were ambiguous
items.leadingRootCause: narrative and coaching text used bare names when the same card person was on both sides
items.implementedFix: packet lists duplicates; validator rejects bare mentions; coaching qualifies them Gold's/Blue's
items.verification: 'Michael Jordan vs Michael Jordan' became 'Gold's … vs Blue's …'

items.description: Key Moments mixed discrete events with game-long patterns
items.leadingRootCause: one deriver emitted both, so 'attacked a mismatch 12 times' sat among single plays
items.implementedFix: derivePatterns split out; separate MATCHUP PATTERNS panel
items.verification: no game-long count appears under KEY MOMENTS

items.description: Candidate 3 single game led into a possibly different-engine Best of 7
items.leadingRootCause: the CTA was engine-agnostic while the preview scope is single-game
items.implementedFix: Best of 7 withdrawn on preview results with an explanation; Rematch stays
items.verification: no Best of 7 control on a Candidate 3 result

items.description: approved player imagery underused
items.leadingRootCause: approved.json is empty, so every card falls back
items.implementedFix: RosterGrid/Ready/hero all render PlayerImage, which serves approved art the moment it exists

items.description: initial roster page top-heavy and duplicated mode selection
items.leadingRootCause: the 7A build added Daily/Ball IQ hero cards, a four-mode row and a marketing strip above the panels
items.implementedFix: all four removed; one compact selected-mode chip; Ball IQ is a draft setting
items.regressionTest: v7b copy test asserts the strip is gone

items.description: Ready state visually sparse
items.leadingRootCause: it was a preview card plus a button
items.implementedFix: navy tipoff band: both fives with portraits, coaches, era, read, one dominant CTA, edit controls

items.description: coach cards too text-dense
items.leadingRootCause: full scouting reports rendered inline
items.implementedFix: one-line summary in the stage; detail lives in the modal behind progressive disclosure
items.verification: coach stage is a summary + Change coach

items.description: Postgame too long, report-like and repetitive
items.leadingRootCause: every section rendered in one column with duplicate team info
items.implementedFix: two-column Final (MVP/moments/patterns | context/breakdown/period), tabs for the rest

items.description: Coaching & Strategy did not show coaching
items.leadingRootCause: it showed usage percentages and a raw edge chart
items.implementedFix: previewCoaching.js surfaces opening mix, pace, initiator, defensive shell + constraints, adjustments with triggers, attacked matchups
items.verification: real values render for Candidate 3; production says it records none

items.description: Save Career did not reflect authentication state
items.leadingRootCause: one button regardless of whether a name was set
items.implementedFix: the control states 'On this device only' vs 'Career saved' — no fake login invented

items.description: Chaos Draft controls asymmetric
items.leadingRootCause: Chaos Draft is a seeded drafting game for YOUR five; Blue is the opposition
items.implementedFix: Manual first on both sides; a line on the Blue panel explains why Chaos Draft is Gold-only

items.description: player Fit labels uninformative (nearly all EXCELLENT)
items.leadingRootCause: the label rendered for every fit value
items.implementedFix: only POOR (OFF-ROLE) and NEUTRAL are surfaced
items.verification: clean cards; a real role problem still shows

items.description: legacy feature-strip language made inaccurate claims
items.leadingRootCause: 'unlock bonuses' and 'AI Game Simulation' were marketing copy predating the engine
items.implementedFix: strip removed entirely; index.html description corrected in 7A

items.description: loading and postgame had to inherit the new theme
items.leadingRootCause: n/a
items.implementedFix: both converted to the arena inset with light-on-navy ink

items.description: Wave 1 access, scenarios, feedback, telemetry, Candidate 3 identity and isolation must survive
items.leadingRootCause: n/a — preservation requirement
items.implementedFix: no engine, access, namespace or key change in this phase
items.verification: preview suites + access audit + deployed QA
